tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is much longer than the pilot window, and the recalled mechanisms make different long-horizon predictions. The slow-horizon probe directly tests the candidate reversal and constrains slow adaptation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow component or its long-horizon reversal.
The pilot has s_grad=0 throughout, leaving the sink dependence unidentified.
More short-horizon resolution would not directly resolve the target-horizon ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to identifying the forecast mechanism.
